title: Catastrophic Cap Standing of a Corrected TRICARE Select Stay
content:
**Standing rule.** Where the family catastrophic total of a corrected **TRICARE Select** stay (the liability posted on the enrollment's claim lines less the liability their reversals withdrew, plus the enrollment fees added, plus any amount credited from TRICARE Prime) has already reached the tier's family catastrophic cap, a corrected stay carries no beneficiary liability; where the room left under the cap once that total is taken away is less than the liability figured under the inpatient basis, the liability is cut to that room, rounded to the cent; otherwise the liability is the one figured under the inpatient basis.

## Caps

| Tier | Family catastrophic cap (US dollars) |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 3000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 4034.00 |

## Judgement

| Family catastrophic total against the cap | Liability on the corrected stay |
|---|---|
| equal to or above the cap | none |
| below the cap, room less than the liability figured under the inpatient basis | the room |
| below the cap, room equal to or more than that liability | the liability figured under the inpatient basis |

## Hypothetical stays (TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, cap 4034.00, liability figured 201.00)

| Total | Room | Liability |
|---|---|---|
| 4034.00 | none | 0.00 |
| 3900.00 | 134.00 | 134.00 |
| 3833.00 | 201.00 | 201.00 |
| 2000.00 | 2034.00 | 201.00 |
